Judge whether the copy matches the brand voice.
Voice guidelines: ['Write plainly and specifically; name the feature and what it does.', "Lead with the customer's trip, not the product's ego.", 'Prefer concrete numbers (weight, capacity, ratings) over adjectives.', "Respect the reader's experience; assume they know the outdoors.", 'Be honest about limits — say what the gear is not built for.', 'One clear call to action per message.']

Subject: VIP Exclusive: 20% Off the Northbay Beacon Headlamp — This Sunday Only
Preview: 400 lumens. 40 hours. 95 grams. Your trail, a little lighter.
Body: You know how much the right light matters when you're three miles from the trailhead and the sky goes dark faster than the forecast said it would.

As one of our VIP members, you get exclusive access to 20% off the Northbay Beacon Headlamp (NB-LMP-05) — but only through Sunday.

Here's what it does:

• 400 lumens of output — enough to read terrain clearly and pick your line on technical ground.
• Up to 40 hours of runtime — so a single charge carries you through a multi-day trip without rationing your light.
• 95 grams — light enough that you stop noticing it on your head.
• USB-C rechargeable — the same cable you're already carrying.

This offer is for VIP members only. It ends Sunday. Use it for the trip you're already planning.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
